The '''Tython Rift''' was a canyon located on the [[Deep Core]] [[planet]] [[Tython]].<ref name="MandoVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tython Rift was mentioned in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian Visual Guide]]'', a [[2026]] reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="MandoVG" /> In [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], the canyon on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] known as the "Rift" first appeared in the [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|preview issue 0]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'', which was written by [[John Ostrander]], pencilled by [[Jan Duursema]], edited by [[Randy Stradley]],<ref name="DOTJ 0">[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|''Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi'' 0]]</ref> and released [[February 1]], [[2012]]<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/20-342/Star-Wars-Dawn-of-the-Jedi-0|text=Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi #0}}</ref>
